title: Record
intro: Photos and videos you take here are fingerprinted and signed on your phone, as a record for you and your lawyer.

capture.cameraPermissionBody: To record evidence, Saakshi needs your camera. Photos and videos stay on your phone.
capture.micPermissionBody: Videos record sound too, so Saakshi needs your microphone.
capture.switchWhileRecording: The camera can’t be switched during a video. Stop the video first.

locker.heading: Your records
locker.missing: This record is no longer on your phone.
locker.checkOkBody: Every file still matches its signed record, and the records are in an unbroken chain.
locker.checkProblemBody_one: {{count}} problem was found. A file or record has changed or is missing since it was recorded.
locker.checkProblemBody_other: {{count}} problems were found. A file or record has changed or is missing since it was recorded.
locker.chainHeadHelp: The SHA-256 of the last signed record. It covers every file above.
locker.deleteBody_one: This deletes {{count}} file, its signed record and any certificate from this phone. It can't be undone. Copies you have already exported or sent are not affected.
locker.deleteBody_other: This deletes {{count}} files, their signed records and any certificate from this phone. It can't be undone. Copies you have already exported or sent are not affected.
locker.deleteBusy: This record is still being recorded, saved or copied. Try again when that has finished.

witness.help: Texts this record’s name, times, place and fingerprints to the people you’ve ticked for witness messages, so that others hold them from today.

certificate.title: Certificate, Part A
certificate.intro: This fills in Part A of the certificate that section 63(4)(c) of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 asks for when electronic records are produced in court, with the hash report attached. The phone's make, model and the SHA-256 of each file are filled in for you.
certificate.partB: The certificate also needs Part B, filled in and signed by an expert. This app cannot provide Part B.
certificate.name: Your full name
certificate.relativeName: Name of your parent or spouse
certificate.imeiHint: Dial *#06# on this phone to see it. If it shows two, enter both, separated by a comma.
certificate.ownership: This phone is, by you (tick all that apply):
certificate.serialHint: Usually in Settings, under About phone.
certificate.signByHand: Print the certificate, then sign it and write the date, time and place by hand.
certificate.required: Fill in your name, your parent's or spouse's name, address and IMEI, and tick at least one box.
certificate.madeBody: It is saved with this record and goes into the bundle when you export it.

grounds.text: “Please tell me the grounds of my arrest, and give them to me in writing.”
grounds.why: Police must tell you why you are arrested, and give it to you in writing in a language you understand, at the latest two hours before you are taken to a magistrate for remand.
grounds.source: Constitution Art. 22(1); BNSS s.47(1); Mihir Rajesh Shah v. State of Maharashtra (SC, 2025), para 56

name.why: An officer making an arrest must wear clear, visible identification of their name.

inform.text: “Please tell [name] that I have been arrested and where I am being held.”
inform.why: Police must tell a relative, friend or other person you name, and must tell you that you have this right.

lawyer.why: You have the right to consult a lawyer of your choice, and to meet them during questioning, though not for all of it.

bail.why: If it is, police must tell you that you can be released on bail.

calm.text: Stay calm, keep your distance, and don't obstruct or resist.
calm.why: Obstructing a public servant, and resisting a lawful arrest, are offences.

statement.text: Say the date, time and place out loud.
statement.why: It helps anyone who watches the recording later.

bodycam.title: Body-cam mode
bodycam.openHint: Wear the phone and keep your hands free. It records video continuously, as one file, fingerprinted and signed every 10 seconds while it records.
bodycam.intro: Wear the phone on your chest, round your neck or clipped to your clothes. It records video continuously, as one file from Start to Stop, and fingerprints and signs what it has recorded every 10 seconds, so even a recording that is cut off can be proven up to that moment. The screen goes dark and touch is locked while it records.
bodycam.unlockBody: While body-cam mode records, the screen is dark and doesn't respond to touch. To unlock it, press the volume-up button twice, quickly.
bodycam.practiseIntro: Try it now, so you know it works on your phone. Start becomes available once you have done it.
bodycam.practiseCameraNote: Your camera turns on during the practice, because iPhone passes the button presses only to an app that is using the camera. Nothing is recorded.
bodycam.practiseDone: Done. That is how you unlock the screen.
bodycam.unlockReminder: To unlock while recording, press volume-up twice.
bodycam.practiseFirst: First practise unlocking the screen, above.
bodycam.iosWarning: On iPhone, video records only while Saakshi is on screen, with its sound in the same file. If you leave the app or lock the phone, video stops and sound keeps recording on its own. When you come back, video starts again, with sound. A phone call pauses the sound recording.
bodycam.androidNote: Recording carries on if you turn the screen off, take a call or use other apps.
bodycam.batteryAndroid: Turn on Battery Saver before you start: body-cam mode keeps the camera running.
bodycam.batteryIos: Turn on Low Power Mode before you start, in Control Centre or Settings > Battery: body-cam mode keeps the camera running.
bodycam.startFailed: Body-cam mode couldn't start. Close Saakshi, open it again and try once more.
bodycam.unavailable: This copy of Saakshi can't record in body-cam mode.
bodycam.locked: Screen locked. Use your unlock buttons.
bodycam.noCheckpointYet: The first checkpoint is signed about 10 seconds after Start.
bodycam.stopFirst: Body-cam is recording. To leave this screen, press Stop and save first.
bodycam.recorderProblem: Part of the recording had a problem. Saakshi carries on recording, and every file it has saved is kept.
bodycam.notificationText: Body-cam mode. Open Saakshi to stop.
bodycam.notificationsOff: Notifications are off for Saakshi, so the recording notice and its Stop button don't show in the notification shade. Recording carries on. To see it from outside Saakshi, pull down the notification shade and open Active apps at the bottom. Stopping Saakshi there closes the whole app; the recording up to that moment is sealed the next time you open it.

battery.warn: Battery {{percent}}%. At 3% the recording will be stopped and saved.
battery.stopped: Battery at 3%: the recording was stopped and saved, so it isn't cut off.

video.shareBody: The original recording (.ts) is your evidence and stays unchanged on this phone. Many phones and computers play an MP4 copy more easily. The copy is made without re-encoding and has its own signed record naming the original. For court, export the bundle, which holds the original.
video.copyMade: MP4 copy for playing (not the original). SHA-256 {{sha256}}

player.heading: The whole recording
player.help: Plays every file of this record, one after the other, with its sound.
player.soundOnly: Sound only: video could not record here, for example while you were away from Saakshi.
player.gap: Nothing was recorded for {{length}} before this file, for example during a phone call.
player.busy: Playing is off while Saakshi is recording, so the recording doesn’t pick it up.
player.error: This file could not be played: {{detail}}
player.soundAlongside: This recording was made with an earlier version of Saakshi, which saved its video without sound and the sound in separate files. This plays the sound; each video file plays on its own below.

photo.missing: This photo is no longer on your phone.

joined.help: For sharing, this record’s files are joined into one MP4 copy, made without re-encoding where the phone can. It is a copy, not the original: the files below stay your evidence, and the copy’s own signed record names each of them. For court, export the bundle.
joined.made: Joined MP4 copy for sharing (not the original). SHA-256 {{sha256}}
joined.madeReencoded: Joined MP4 copy for sharing (not the original; the phone had to re-encode it). SHA-256 {{sha256}}

error.turned: These video files were filmed with different cameras (front and back) or turned different ways, so this phone can’t join them without re-encoding. Share each video on its own instead.
error.one-video: This record has only one video file; share it on its own.
error.unsealed: Not every file of this record is sealed yet. Try again in a moment.

ended.label: Ended: {{reason}}
ended.pieceComplete: This piece was complete; the next one carried on.
ended.appLeft: Stopped when you left Saakshi or locked the phone. (iPhone records video only while Saakshi is on screen.)
ended.cameraInUse: Stopped because another app took the camera.
ended.systemPressure: Stopped because the phone was under strain, for example too hot.
ended.cameraLost: Stopped because the camera stopped working.
ended.audioInterrupted: Sound stopped, for example for a phone call.
ended.soundResumed: Ended so that the next file has sound again.
ended.interrupted: Cut off: the app closed or the phone switched off. It plays up to the cut, and was sealed when the app next opened.
ended.error: Ended because the file could not be written.
